integrity: The value, minimizer classification, and counting formulas are proved analytically from row and column counts. The bundled exhaustive computation is only a finite stress test. Search noncoverage is not treated as proof of novelty; a residual literature risk is recorded explicitly.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to ordinary 2-domination on Cartesian products of two complete graphs. It does not determine higher-threshold ordinary domination, total 2-domination, or products of general factors. The 2009 square-rook predecessor was available only at abstract/metadata level, leaving a stated terminology-overlap risk.
title: Exact 2-domination and minimizer counts on Hamming rectangles
